items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I had -- when I first went I took Earl Hyde on drums, and George Duvivier... They went with me the first time, and the second time, for that matter.

ctx.x: What musicians did you take with you?

I had -- when I first went I took Earl Hyde on drums, and George Duvivier, who's today one of the greatest and one of the finest bass players around, amongst the finest. They went with me the first time, and the second time, for that matter. And it was just tremendous, really. The response was so very great, until I couldn't believe it, when you'd play these halls over there, you know. I guess this was their chief form of entertainment. I'm trying to remember what they call them. They don't call them vaudeville…
